mapper.select: SELECT a.*,m.public_id AS cover_asset_public_id FROM anniversary a LEFT JOIN media_asset m ON m.asset_id=a.cover_asset_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY a.sort,a.date,a.anniversary_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO anniversary(user_id,space_id,title,date,description,cover_asset_id,sort) VALUES(#{userId},(SELECT space_id FROM diary_space WHERE personal_owner_id=#{userId}),#{title},#{date},#{description},#{coverAssetId},#{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE anniversary SET title=#{title},date=#{date},description=#{description},cover_asset_id=#{coverAssetId},sort=#{sort} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND anniversary_id=#{anniversaryId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM anniversary WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND anniversary_id=#{anniversaryId}
